Messages.Author: madma...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Fellow Methusalehs:

I have a couple of questions concerning vampire abilities:

Melissa Barton gains 1 blood if a Methuselah forfeits the Edge for a
vote. Question: does Melissa have to be ready, or just controlled??

"If Violet Tremain successfully inflicts at least 2 hand damage to an
opposing vampire in a combat, reduce that vampire's capacity by 1 at
the end of combat." (quote from Monger). If Violet used the new
Kraken's Kiss card, which does "Strike: strength+1 ranged damage",
would this fulfill her special ability requirements? I would guess
not, since the ability talks about "2 hand damage" which would imply a
hand strike. If she used Brass Knuckles, would that qualify??

Thanks in advance,
Madman

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Sun, 5 Nov 2000 madma...@my-deja.com wrote:

> Melissa Barton gains 1 blood if a Methuselah forfeits the Edge for a
> vote. Question: does Melissa have to be ready, or just controlled??

Controlled. It doesn't require her to be ready.

> "If Violet Tremain successfully inflicts at least 2 hand damage to an
> opposing vampire in a combat, reduce that vampire's capacity by 1 at
> the end of combat." (quote from Monger). If Violet used the new
> Kraken's Kiss card, which does "Strike: strength+1 ranged damage",
> would this fulfill her special ability requirements?

Well, a hand strike is non-ranged and hand strikes deal hand damage.

Whether there are non hand strikes which can also deal hand damage I don't
know. One for LSJ.

> I would guess
> not, since the ability talks about "2 hand damage" which would imply a
> hand strike. If she used Brass Knuckles, would that qualify??

Melee weaposn always inflict melee weapon damage, not hand damage.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
James Coupe <jr...@cam.ac.uk> wrote:
> On Sun, 5 Nov 2000 madma...@my-deja.com wrote:
> > Melissa Barton gains 1 blood if a Methuselah forfeits the Edge for a
> > vote. Question: does Melissa have to be ready, or just controlled??
> Controlled. It doesn't require her to be ready.

Correct.

> > "If Violet Tremain successfully inflicts at least 2 hand damage...

> Well, a hand strike is non-ranged and hand strikes deal hand damage.
>
> Whether there are non hand strikes which can also deal hand damage I
don't
> know. One for LSJ.

No. Hand damage is the type of damage done by a hand strike.
Strikes that are not hand strikes cannot deal hand damage.

> Melee weaposn always inflict melee weapon damage, not hand damage.

Correct.

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <8ua2uc$b86$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>, <take...@my-deja.com> wrote:
>Can I use Karaken kiss with body arsenal????????'

After a fashion. Kraken's Kiss will benefit from Body Arsenal's +1 strength
at superior (so the strike will be at a total of +2 strength, typically for
3 damage), but is not hand damage, and therefore will not be aggravated. Not
the most efficient use of 2 blood, but any port in a storm.

gomi
